metadata.title: Tesla Notches Over Twofold Increase in European Monthly Sales - WSJ

content.text:
Tesla TSLA 1.14%increase; up pointing triangle logged a more than twofold jump in European monthly sales in May as Elon Musk’s electric-vehicle maker continues to rebuild strength in a region where Chinese rivals are gaining ground.
New-car registrations for Tesla models, a reflection of sales, more than doubled on year last month to 28,610 units across the European Union, the U.K., Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland, according to the European Automobile Manufacturers’ Association, an industry body also known as ACEA. In the EU alone, Tesla sold 21,767 vehicles, also more than double from a year earlier.
